messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
I’ve computed a property for a series of frames. I’m wondering if there is a straightforward way to reshuffle these frames to form a pseudo trajectory with the frames in the order in which the property increases.
Best,
Matthew

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
Currently you would have to do it via a series of 'trajin' commands
which is not very elegant. It's a good idea for a feature: I've
created an issue on the cpptraj GitHub site and will try to implement
it soon: https://github.com/Amber-MD/cpptraj/issues/918
-Dan
